No, 9.11 is **not** greater than 9.9. In fact, 9.9 is greater than 9.11.

Here’s why:
- 9.9 can be written as 9.90.
- Comparing digit by digit:
  - Both numbers have 9 in the units place.
  - 9.90 has a 9 in the tenths place, while 9.11 has a 1 in the tenths place.
  - Since 9 > 1 in the tenths place, 9.90 (or 9.9) is greater than 9.11.

So, **9.9 > 9.11**.
